italian-reading-10.title: Double consonants
italian-reading-10.subtitle: Hear the difference between a short and longer sound
italian-reading-10.description: Learn to notice doubled consonants in writing and hear how they can distinguish words.

ir10-p1.translations: At home, Anna puts the shovel in the box. Her son plays with the ball.

ir10-t1.text: Hold a doubled consonant longer than a single one.

ir10-t2.text: Compare both spelling and sound: pala/palla, casa/cassa.

ir10_q1.question: In which word is the letter L doubled in writing?

ir10_q2.question: Which word has a doubled consonant?
